# Frequently Asked Questions - Arcade Hub

Lang: en
Website: [https://menj.buzz/arcade/](https://menj.buzz/arcade/)
Last Updated: 2026-10-06

---

Q: What is Arcade Hub?
A: A free set of small browser games hosted at menj.buzz/arcade/.

---

Q: Do the games need an account?
A: No. Best scores are kept in the browser's local storage on the player's device.

---

Q: Are there ads?
A: Ads are off by default. If enabled, nothing loads from Google until the visitor accepts the consent prompt.

---
